name: neobrutalism-buttons
title: Buttons
description: Neobrutalism-style button components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and interactive hover states. Perfect for calls-to-action, forms, and navigation with a bold, retro design.
useWhen: Offering a clear primary or secondary action within a high-contrast neobrutalist interface.
Making tactile pressed states part of the visual interaction language.
avoidWhen: Presenting a navigation link to another document.
Showing too many visually dominant actions in one group.
responsiveBehavior: Buttons retain generous tap targets and can wrap in action groups on small screens. Pressed transforms must not shift surrounding layout.
accessibility: Use semantic button elements for actions and visible focus states.
Icon-only buttons require an accessible name.
